external_games.name: Lego Star Wars: Empire vs. Rebels

name: Lego Star Wars: Empire vs. Rebels
storyline:
The old Republic and the Jedi Order have fallen. Now the Empire rules! But a team of heroes still battles against the tyranny of the Emperor and his henchmen. They try to outwit and outmaneuver the
Empire's forces, causing mischief wherever they can and then
disappearing before they can be caught. Ezra Bridger is the newest recruit to join this band of rebels. Help him explore and collect the vital bricks that the rebels need in their quest to take down the Empire. And if Ezra can mess up some Imperial plans along the way, that's even better!
summary: The goal of the game is to find a certain character, either Darth Vader or Kanan Jarrus, in each stage. In the process, players can take different paths and collect collectibles, which can either unlock additional playable characters or short video clips.
